newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's OM to open pulp futures, options market.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's OM to open pulp futures, options market.

text.p: Swedish-based derivatives trader OM Gruppen AB on Tuesday said it will set up a bourse, called PULPEX, for trading in futures and options in pulp on May 29.
"The need for PULPEX has grown at a pace that price fluctuations on pulp have become more drastic," the OM Group said in a statement.
PULPEX will be based in London on the OMLX, the London Securities & Exchange Derivatives Exchange owned by OM, and through a link to OM Stockholm will be distributed to Europe.

It said that the following financial operators had said they would trade on the market: Merita Bank, Stockholm-based JP Bank, Citibank, GNI of London, Sucden of London, Merrill Lynch of London, Refco of London, Fimat Derivatives of Canada and Enskilda Futures of London.
